name: A Proposal for a Three Detector Short-Baseline Neutrino Oscillation Program in the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam

summary.plain: The 2015 proposal that set up the Short-Baseline Neutrino programme: three liquid-argon detectors on one Fermilab beamline, hunting for a possible fourth kind of neutrino.
summary.technical: arXiv:1503.01520: joint proposal of the ICARUS-WA104, LAr1-ND (later SBND) and MicroBooNE collaborations for a three-detector liquid-argon short-baseline neutrino oscillation program on the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam, refurbishing the ICARUS T600 as the far detector.
